report.summary: 3 items: define GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS in attempt.py, audit job_accounting reads before close in _spawn_pytest, and compare Ollama/DeepSeek _CHECK_POLICY and fanout/session validation.
risks: Adding GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS may change summary output; ensure tests pass.
Auditing _spawn_pytest may reveal missing read; fix may require restructuring.
Comparing policies may find exploitable weakness; fix may require backporting checks.
todos: Define GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS in daedalus/spine/attempt.py with a reasonable default (e.g., 200).
Run GateResult.summary on an instance to verify no NameError.
Inspect daedalus/eval/harness.py for _spawn_pytest and ensure job_accounting read before close.
Grep _CHECK_POLICY in ollama.py and deepseek.py; compare policies.
Grep daedalus/lanes/fanout.py and daedalus/council/session.py for additional validation.

items.title: Define GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS constant in attempt.py
items.why_now: Without it, GateResult.summary raises NameError on every call, breaking any feature that uses summary (e.g., logs, reports). This is a critical runtime error.

steps.do: Add GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS = 200 (or appropriate value) near the top of daedalus/spine/attempt.py.
steps.verified_by: Run: python -c "from daedalus.spine.attempt import GateResult; r = GateResult(outcome='pass', output='x'*500); print(r.summary())" - should print truncated output without NameError.

items.assumption: The constant is indeed missing; the cited source shows it is not defined in attempt.py or eval/__main__.py. No other module defines it.

items.title: Audit job_accounting read before close in _spawn_pytest
items.why_now: If _spawn_pytest does not read job_accounting before close, accounting data is lost, breaking budget tracking for test runs. This is a high severity data loss risk.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/eval/harness.py (or wherever _spawn_pytest is defined) to verify job_accounting is read before proc context manager exits. If missing, add read before close.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'job_accounting' daedalus/eval/harness.py should show a read before close. Also run tests to ensure no regression.

items.assumption: _spawn_pytest is in daedalus/eval/harness.py. If not, adjust path.

items.title: Compare Ollama and DeepSeek _CHECK_POLICY and cross-module validation
items.why_now: If Ollama's policy is weaker and no cross-module validation exists, malicious output could bypass safety checks. This is a high severity security risk.

steps.do: Extract _CHECK_POLICY from daedalus/providers/ollama.py and daedalus/providers/deepseek.py; compare contents.
steps.verified_by: Output the grep results and manually compare policies.

steps.do: Grep daedalus/lanes/fanout.py and daedalus/council/session.py for any validation, sanitize, or filter calls.

items.assumption: The full _CHECK_POLICY is in those files; the cited source only shows first 30 lines. Full extraction needed.
